definitions.full: H336. i IV. אִי adverb not (frequently in Rabb, as אֶפְשַׁר אִי impossible ; and in Ethiopic the ordinary negative; compare Phoenician אי CIS i, 3, 5 , and in איבל 165; 18; 167; 11 ; Assyrian ai ) Job 22:30 אִינָֿקִי the non-innocent . ** 22:30 : read perhaps אֵל (Me), or אֱלֹהַּ (Ley), with וְתִמָּלֵט in verse b.
